description: Mada hii inafundisha stadi za ufahamu kama vile kutambua wazo kuu, hoja saidizi, maana ya maneno katika muktadha, kutoa muhtasari na kuhitimisha.

mcq.questionText: Soma kifungu kifuatacho kisha ujibu swali. "Asha huamka mapema kila siku. Hujisafisha, hula chakula cha asubuhi, kisha huelekea shuleni. Akifika darasani, hukaa kimya akimsikiliza mwalimu kwa makini." Wazo kuu la kifungu hiki ni lipi?

options.text: Asha ni mwanafunzi mwenye nidhamu na bidii

mcq.explanation: The passage shows Asha's discipline through her daily routine of waking early and listening attentively in class.

mcq.questionText: Soma kifungu kisha ujibu. "Mvua ilinyesha sana usiku kucha. Asubuhi, njia ya kwenda shuleni ilijaa matope. Wanafunzi wengi walichelewa kufika darasani." Kwa nini wanafunzi walichelewa?
mcq.explanation: The passage directly states the path was full of mud after the rain, causing the delay.

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi "Juma ni mtoto mtiifu sana nyumbani", neno "mtiifu" lina maana gani?
mcq.explanation: In context, 'mtiifu' means obedient, one who listens and complies.

mcq.questionText: Soma kifungu. "Baba alimnunulia Neema baiskeli mpya. Neema alifurahi sana akamshukuru baba yake. Tangu siku hiyo, Neema huitumia baiskeli kwenda shuleni." Neema alipewa nini na baba yake?
mcq.explanation: The passage states the father bought Neema a new bicycle.

mcq.questionText: Stadi ya kutambua wazo kuu la kifungu humaanisha nini?

options.text: Kutambua ujumbe mkuu unaobebwa na kifungu

mcq.explanation: The main idea is the central message that the whole passage carries.

mcq.questionText: Soma kifungu. "Bustani ya shule yetu ina miti mingi ya matunda. Wanafunzi humwagilia miti hiyo kila jioni. Kwa sababu hii, shule yetu huonekana ya kijani na nzuri." Ni hoja saidizi gani inayoonyesha utunzaji wa bustani?
mcq.explanation: The supporting detail showing care of the garden is that students water the trees every evening.

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi "Mwalimu aliwasifu wanafunzi waliofanya vizuri mtihani", neno "aliwasifu" lina maana gani?
mcq.explanation: In context, 'aliwasifu' means he praised/commended them.

mcq.questionText: Soma kifungu. "Mama hupika chakula nyumbani kila siku. Watoto humsaidia kuosha vyombo na kufagia. Kwa pamoja, kazi za nyumbani humaliziwa haraka." Muhtasari bora wa kifungu hiki ni upi?

options.text: Ushirikiano kati ya mama na watoto hurahisisha kazi za nyumbani

mcq.explanation: The best summary captures that cooperation between mother and children makes housework faster.

mcq.questionText: Kutoa muhtasari wa kifungu kunamaanisha nini?

options.text: Kueleza mambo makuu ya kifungu kwa ufupi

mcq.explanation: Summarizing means stating the main points of a passage briefly.

mcq.questionText: Soma kifungu. "Hamisi alisahau kufanya kazi yake ya nyumbani. Asubuhi alipofika shuleni, alishtuka. Aliomba msamaha kwa mwalimu na kuahidi kutosahau tena." Tunaweza kuhitimisha nini kuhusu Hamisi?

options.text: Hamisi alijutia kosa lake na ana nia ya kubadilika
Hamisi hakuwa na kazi ya nyumbani

mcq.explanation: We can conclude Hamisi regretted his mistake and intends to change, as he apologized and promised.

mcq.questionText: Soma kifungu. "Shule yetu ina maktaba kubwa yenye vitabu vingi. Wanafunzi hupenda kusoma humo wakati wa mapumziko. Maktaba husaidia kuongeza maarifa." Kusudi kuu la maktaba kwa mujibu wa kifungu ni nini?
mcq.explanation: The passage states the library helps increase students' knowledge.

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi "Mvulana yule ni mchapakazi, hufanya kila kazi kwa bidii", neno "mchapakazi" lina maana gani?

options.text: Mtu mwenye kufanya kazi kwa bidii

mcq.explanation: The context clarifies 'mchapakazi' means a hardworking person.

mcq.questionText: Soma kifungu. "Rehema ni kiongozi wa darasa. Huwasaidia wenzake kuelewa masomo magumu. Walimu humwamini kwa sababu ya uaminifu wake." Kwa nini walimu humwamini Rehema?
mcq.explanation: The passage states teachers trust Rehema because of her honesty.

mcq.questionText: Ni jambo gani la muhimu kufanya kabla ya kujibu maswali ya ufahamu?

options.text: Kusoma kifungu kwa makini na kuelewa

mcq.explanation: Reading the passage carefully and understanding it is essential before answering comprehension questions.

mcq.questionText: Soma kifungu. "Wanafunzi walifanya usafi wa darasa zima. Walifagia sakafu, wakafuta madirisha na kupanga madawati. Mwalimu aliwapongeza kwa kazi nzuri." Mwalimu aliwapongeza wanafunzi kwa sababu gani?
mcq.explanation: The teacher praised them for doing a good job cleaning the classroom.

fib.questionText: Ujumbe mkuu unaobebwa na kifungu chote huitwa wazo _____.
fib.explanation: The central message of a passage is the main idea (wazo kuu).

fib.questionText: Maelezo yanayounga mkono wazo kuu huitwa hoja _____.
fib.explanation: Details that support the main idea are called supporting points (hoja saidizi).

fib.questionText: Kabla ya kujibu maswali ya ufahamu, ni lazima kwanza _____ kifungu kwa makini.
fib.explanation: One must first read the passage carefully before answering.

fib.questionText: Kueleza mambo makuu ya kifungu kwa ufupi huitwa kutoa _____.
fib.explanation: Stating the main points briefly is called summarizing (muhtasari).

fib.questionText: Kutoa hukumu au uamuzi kutokana na taarifa za kifungu huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: Drawing a judgment from the passage's information is concluding (kuhitimisha).

fib.questionText: Maana ya neno kulingana na sentensi lilipotumika huitwa maana katika _____.
fib.explanation: A word's meaning based on its sentence is meaning in context (muktadha).

fib.questionText: Mtu anayefanya kazi kwa bidii huitwa _____.
Mwanafunzi anayetii sheria na maagizo huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: A student who obeys rules is 'mtiifu' (obedient).

fib.questionText: Kifungu cha habari kinachosomwa ili kueleweka huitwa kifungu cha _____.
fib.explanation: A passage read for understanding is a comprehension passage (kifungu cha ufahamu).

fib.questionText: Stadi ya kutafsiri ujumbe usiosemwa wazi kwenye kifungu huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: Interpreting hidden messages relates to comprehension skills (ufahamu).

tf.questionText: Wazo kuu ni ujumbe mkuu unaobebwa na kifungu kizima.
tf.explanation: True. The main idea is the central message of the whole passage.

tf.questionText: Hoja saidizi ni maelezo yanayoungana na wazo kuu.
tf.explanation: True. Supporting points back up the main idea.

tf.questionText: Si lazima kusoma kifungu kabla ya kujibu maswali ya ufahamu.
tf.explanation: False. One must read the passage carefully before answering.

tf.questionText: Kutoa muhtasari kunamaanisha kueleza mambo makuu kwa ufupi.
tf.explanation: True. Summarizing means stating the main points briefly.

tf.questionText: Maana ya neno katika muktadha hutegemea jinsi neno lilivyotumika kwenye sentensi.
tf.explanation: True. Contextual meaning depends on how the word is used in the sentence.

tf.questionText: Kuhitimisha ni kukariri kifungu chote bila kuelewa.
tf.explanation: False. Concluding means drawing a judgment from the information, not memorizing.

tf.questionText: Muhtasari mzuri huwa na maneno mengi kuliko kifungu asilia.
tf.explanation: False. A good summary is shorter than the original passage.

tf.questionText: Neno "mtiifu" lina maana ya mtu anayetii.
Stadi za ufahamu hujumuisha kutambua wazo kuu na hoja saidizi.
tf.explanation: True. Comprehension skills include identifying the main idea and supporting points.

tf.questionText: Katika ufahamu, majibu huandikwa kabla ya kusoma swali.
tf.explanation: False. One must read the question and passage before answering.

summary.questionText: Taja stadi inayohusu kutambua ujumbe mkuu wa kifungu.
summary.explanation: Identifying the main idea of a passage.

summary.questionText: Taja stadi inayohusu kueleza mambo makuu kwa ufupi.
Taja stadi inayohusu kutoa hukumu kutokana na taarifa za kifungu.
summary.explanation: Drawing a conclusion from the passage information.

summary.questionText: Taja kitu kinachoungana na wazo kuu ili kukithibitisha.
summary.explanation: Supporting points that reinforce the main idea.

summary.questionText: Eleza maana ya "maana ya neno katika muktadha".
summary.correctAnswer: Maana ya neno kulingana na matumizi yake katika sentensi
summary.explanation: A word's meaning as determined by its use in the sentence.

summary.questionText: Taja jambo la kwanza kufanya kabla ya kujibu maswali ya ufahamu.
summary.explanation: Reading the passage carefully comes first.

summary.questionText: Taja sifa ya muhtasari mzuri kuhusu urefu.
summary.explanation: A good summary is shorter than the original passage.

summary.questionText: Taja neno la Kiswahili lenye maana ya mtu anayefanya kazi kwa bidii.
Taja neno la Kiswahili lenye maana ya mtu anayetii.
Taja jina la kifungu cha habari kinachosomwa kwa lengo la kukielewa.
summary.explanation: A comprehension passage is read to be understood.

hoq.questionText: Soma kifungu. "Kila siku Salima hubeba mwavuli shuleni hata kama jua linawaka. Wenzake humcheka, lakini Salima hujibu kwa tabasamu tu." Tunaweza kuhitimisha nini kuhusu tabia ya Salima?

options.text: Salima ni mtu wa kujiandaa na mwenye subira

hoq.explanation: We infer Salima is prepared (always carrying an umbrella) and patient (responding to mockery with a smile).

hoq.questionText: Soma kifungu. "Baada ya mvua kunyesha, mama aliangalia paa lililovuja kisha akahema. Akawaambia watoto kuweka ndoo chini ya tone la maji." Tunaweza kudokeza nini kuhusu hali ya nyumba yao?

options.text: Nyumba yao ina hitaji la matengenezo

hoq.explanation: The leaking roof and need for buckets imply the house needs repair.

hoq.questionText: Soma kifungu. "Tunda lilikuwa limeiva sana hata likaanguka chini lenyewe. Watoto walikusanyika wakitaka kuliokota." Tunaweza kuhitimisha nini kuhusu tunda hilo?

options.text: Tunda lilikuwa limekomaa na tayari kuliwa

hoq.explanation: Since it was very ripe and fell on its own and children wanted it, we infer it was ripe and ready to eat.
